correctness.rationale: Every face of the finite convex cone has a strict KKT witness and orthogonal Jacobian H_A. On the quotient by constants, first differences factor each Jacobian as D H_A J. The piecewise linear segment argument proves the global maximum-column formula, while strict-complementarity step perturbations prove finite-distance attainability. The bundled exact-Fraction verifier exhaustively checks all 127 active sets for n=2,...,8, projection identities, seven exact constants and exact KKT witnesses. Face embedding proves monotonicity for all n. No finite enumeration is claimed to establish an infinite asymptotic.

Direct comparison of their statements, active-face operators and norm transformations shows neither implies the new sharp BV seminorm threshold, exact values, or global monotonicity. Primary full scientific materials were inspected where available; earlier unindexed equivalents remain a residual priority risk.

value.rationale: Path total variation of the difference of two fitted signals is a natural stability measurement for shape-constrained regression. Establishing the exact first expansive dimension n=4, sharp ratio 6/5, additional nontrivial sharp constants through n=8, an all-dimensional finite formula and monotonicity gives a concrete structural answer for a widely used nonlinear projection. The eight-site factor 11/7 already exceeds the affine-fit limiting factor 3/2; this is a mathematically motivated comparison, not an arbitrary table or routine restatement.
